questions: Can we choose the same bag for both A and B in an operation (i.e., move stones from a bag to itself)?
Are we allowed to perform zero operations, i.e., must we consider the initial configuration's XOR?
Does the order of bags matter for the final XOR, i.e., is B_i the final content of bag labeled i, or just the multiset of final bag contents?
After moving stones from bag A to bag B, can bag A later receive stones from another bag in a subsequent operation?
Is the operation allowed only between two distinct bags, or can A and B be the same?
Are we required to minimize or maximize the number of operations, or is any sequence allowed?
Do we consider the XOR of the final bag contents regardless of which bag they are in, or does the label of the bag affect the XOR calculation?
Can we have multiple stones in a bag, and does the XOR operation depend on the integer value of the total stones in each bag?
